Use our specification checklist to compare facade quotations in India.
- [DGU vs Triple Glazing: Performance & Selection](https://fineglaze.com/blog/double-glazed-units-dgu-vs-triple-glazing-commercial-facade-india): Understand DGU and triple glazing, U-value, SHGC and acoustic glass. Compare full glazing specifications before selecting a commercial facade system.
- [Structural Glazing Cost: Compare the Full Scope](https://fineglaze.com/blog/structural-glazing-cost-per-sq-ft-india-2026-price-guide): Compare structural glazing costs, silicone systems, spider fittings and installation scope. Learn which documents to request before accepting a facade quote.
- [Fire-Rated ACP: Ratings, Documents & Cost Factors](https://fineglaze.com/blog/fire-rated-acp-sheet-cladding-cost-nbc-fire-safety-norms-india): Understand ACP fire ratings, mineral cores and facade assembly documents. Compare cladding specifications and quotation scope without relying on an FR label.
- [Facade Water Leakage: Diagnosis & Repair Guide](https://fineglaze.com/blog/facade-water-leakage-rectification-monsoon-waterproofing-guide-india): Find the causes of glass facade leaks, sealant failure and blocked drainage. Use a practical investigation and repair checklist before the next monsoon.
- [System Aluminium Windows & Thermal Breaks](https://fineglaze.com/blog/system-aluminium-windows-vs-conventional-sliding-fenestration-cost): Compare system aluminium and conventional sliding windows. Check thermal breaks, drainage, air leakage, hardware and complete-window performance before buying.
- [Aluminium Sun Louvers: Design & Cost Factors](https://fineglaze.com/blog/architectural-aluminium-sun-louvers-aerofoil-fins-energy-reduction): Plan aluminium sun louvers and aerofoil fins around orientation, daylight, wind loads and access. Compare fixed and operable shading with a buyer checklist.
- [Frameless Balcony Railings: Systems & Safety](https://fineglaze.com/blog/frameless-glass-railing-balustrade-cost-hardware-safety-standards-india): Compare base-shoe and spigot glass railings using tested systems, glass build-up, anchors and slab details. Prepare a clear high-rise balcony specification.
- [Facade AMC: Scope, Checklist & Cost Drivers](https://fineglaze.com/blog/facade-amc-commercial-building-maintenance-checklist-cost-india): Define a commercial facade AMC with inspections, cleaning, sealant repairs and reporting. Compare exclusions, response terms, access and maintenance costs.
- [Sustainable Facades: ECBC, ECSBC & Design Choices](https://fineglaze.com/blog/sustainable-green-building-facade-design-leed-igbc-ecbc-compliance-india): Coordinate solar control, daylight, glazing and thermal bridges for sustainable facades. Understand ECBC, ECSBC and project-specific green-building requirements.
- [Office Glass Partitions: Cost & Acoustic Choices](https://fineglaze.com/blog/frameless-glass-office-partitions-cost-design-guide-2026): Choose frameless office glass partitions by privacy, acoustics, doors and hardware. Compare glass build-ups and installed scope using our quote checklist.
- [Commercial Facade Inspection: A Practical Checklist](https://fineglaze.com/blog/commercial-facade-inspection-maintenance-checklist-2026): Plan a facade inspection covering glass, seals, drainage, anchors and safe access. Learn what a useful condition report should record before repair decisions.
- [Spider Glazing: Fittings, Glass & Design Guide](https://fineglaze.com/blog/spider-glazing-systems-benefits-cost-india): Understand point-supported spider glazing, glass fins, fittings and movement. Use a project checklist to compare atrium, entrance and canopy proposals.
- [Monsoon Facade Maintenance: Before & After Rain](https://fineglaze.com/blog/facade-safety-during-monsoon-india): Prepare glass facades for monsoon rain with seal, drainage and access checks. Record leaks safely and plan repairs using a clear building-maintenance scope.
- [Glass Railing Design: Safety, Supports & Cost](https://fineglaze.com/blog/glass-railing-design-safety-guide-india): Choose residential glass railings using glass build-up, supports, anchors and breakage behaviour. Compare balcony and staircase quotations on a clear scope.
